identity.title: Does God Exist?  (Frank Turek vs Dennis Nørmark)
identity.dateBasis: Uploader description explicitly identifies March 2014 at Skywalk Church, Randers, Denmark. Upload date is 12 August 2017, not the event year.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Named introductions, scheduled uninterrupted opening and rebuttal turns, explicit handoffs and first-person positions through complete controller transcript review.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: All 3,457 events retained. Both openings, rebuttals, discussion and closings present. Danish opening logistics and post-closing thanks are outside the substantive window. Four gaps over ten seconds sit at speech transitions or applause in caption context; no material missing exchange identified. Automatic final caption extends 719 ms beyond nominal duration.
content.captionCaution: Automatic captions have recognition errors. Preserve original words and do not score corrupted technical vocabulary, names, apparent negations or references as participant defects. Material uncertainty requires audio verification.

participants.dyadicGateMeaning: Exactly two scored primary speakers under express editor-approved-moderator-context-v1 authority. Original recording is not certified strictly dyadic.

editorApprovedScope.userApproval: The user answered “Yes—use the disclosed two-speaker assessment” to: “May I score only Frank Turek and Dennis Nørmark across the full debate, treating moderator Adam Holm’s arguments as context, evaluating the debaters’ own replies, and clearly disclosing this exception?”
editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: By explicit editorial approval, this assessment scores only Frank Turek and Dennis Nørmark across the substantive debate. Moderator Adam Holm contributes independent arguments and challenges, which remain context; the debaters’ own replies remain eligible for assessment. No moderator argument is credited to either debater. Unequal questioning is considered when selecting moves and evaluating opportunities to respond. This is a recording-specific exception to the ordinary two-speaker source rule.
editorApprovedScope.scopeInterpretation: Turek argues that cosmology, fine-tuning, objective morality and resurrection evidence favor God and Christianity. Nørmark initially says he does not know with certainty and considers God improbable; he argues for natural explanations, humanism and materialism. Do not impose a universal disproof burden or reduce his adopted positive naturalistic claims to mere withholding of belief.

participants.questionHandling: Moderator interventions are context only. Primary speakers’ own answers remain eligible; host-only prompts do not create selected opponent moves. Account for unequal questioning and do not transfer host arguments to either side.

duplicateAudit.method: Fresh origin/main video ID, speaker spelling variants and pairing checked across production data, registry and ledgers.
